title: situation.manassas_advance_received.title

gate.none: Military observation and administrative order only; no civilian-conduct, secession-motive or protected-population effect.

citations.at: I-2 pp.473,478,980-982: Cooper, 17 July; Johnston acknowledgement, 18 July; report of the advance and conditional junction. [I] Cooper's office supplies the government summary, not a quotation or an invented Walker intervention. A real marching operation causes this summary; the ordinary report route carries it to the principal, without revealing private goals or forcing arrival.

namedOnly: A summary of the cited military correspondence, without new personal speech or motives.
